relationships.subject: intrathecal therapy
relationships.evidence_quote: Direct administration of analgesics to the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) bypasses the BBB and allows for more rapid analgesia.

relationships.subject: opioids
relationships.evidence_quote: Opioids act at mu receptors in the dorsal horn, reducing neurotransmitter release and hyperpolarizing dorsal horn neurons

relationships.subject: ziconotide
relationships.evidence_quote: Ziconotide antagonizes N-type voltage-sensitive calcium channels on presynaptic nerve terminals at the dorsal horn.

relationships.subject: baclofen
relationships.evidence_quote: Baclofen, a GABA-A receptor agonist, can be effective in combination therapy for neuropathic pain with spasticity.

key_findings: Review of SCS and intrathecal drug delivery for cancer-related neuropathic pain
Intrathecal delivery bypasses the BBB allowing lower doses and fewer systemic side effects
